_comment: POI catalogue and defaults. Edit this file, then run: python3 scripts/generate_poi_config.py. It rewrites the generated parts of the tag-mapping XMLs, the VTM theme and (add-only) tags-to-keep.json. The web page offers every POI of this list (label = name shown there); the user's choices are stored apart and never change this file. zoom = zoom level from which the POI is stored and drawn. size = icon size in percent (optional, default 100). enabled = false: offered in the web page but not on by default. icon = an SVG of themes/vtm/icons, or shape:<circle|square|triangle|diamond>:<red|blue|green|yellow|purple|orange|black|white>. hide_if = POI is not drawn when one of these tags has one of these values. variants = other icon when a secondary tag has a given value; the default icon is used when the tag is absent or has another value.
